summary: Blackstone Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K reporting a small private placement of 150,127 unregistered Class I common shares for $3,543,000, finalized September 21, 2026, under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S. It also declared September distributions of $0.1800 gross per Class I and S share and $0.1633/$0.1751 net, record September 30, payable October 27, and disclosed August 31 NAV of $23.60 per share across classes, $43.2 billion aggregate NAV, $76.4 billion portfolio fair value, and $35.8 billion debt. These are routine BDC capital and disclosure events, not a special situation.
